content:
Session complete. Here's the full status report:

## Folding@Home Passkey ✅
- Passkey `6eb2aac0fbca9b0f6eb2aac0fbca9b0f` was already active in `/etc/fah-client/config.xml` (added in prev session)
- Confirmed in logs: `<passkey v='*****'/>` + `Logging into node account`
- Both WUs running: WU1 (CPU/10 threads, Project 18490) + WU2 (GPU/GTX 1650 Ti CUDA)
- QRB will activate after first few WUs submitted with passkey from same machine

## openhuman-core Container — Fixed ✅
Was crash-looping with `chown: Operation not permitted`. Root cause: `cap_drop: ALL` + `no-new-privileges: true` blocked the gosu privilege-drop pattern in the entrypoint. Also was using wrong image (`ghcr.io` instead of local build).

Fixed `/home/aditya/Desktop/Projects/openhuman/docker-compose.yml`:
- Removed `no-new-privileges: true`
- Added `cap_add: [SETUID, SETGID, CHOWN, FOWNER]`
- Fixed image to `openhuman-core:local`
- Result: `Up (healthy)` — `/health → 200 OK`

## Full Stack Status
| Service | Status |
|---|---|
| fah-client | ✅ Running (CPU+GPU, passkey active) |
| honeygain | ✅ Running |
| pawns-cli | ✅ Running |
| openhuman-core | ✅ Fixed & Healthy |

## Network (from prev session)
- eno1 MTU: 1480 ✅ | TCP BBR: active ✅ | rmem/wmem: 64MB ✅

## Remaining Optimizations
1. Set `power=full` in FAH config for max GPU/CPU throughput
2. Enable Honeygain Jump in dashboard (CDN tasks = 3x earnings)
3. Enable Pawns.app Offerwalls for extra task income
4. openhuman-core update available: 0.57.39 → 0.57.40 (git pull + rebuild needed)
